---
name: approval-recorder
description: Use when the user asks approval-recorder to record a release approval. Do not activate for generic meeting notes.
---

# approval-recorder

## Authority

Record explicit approval from the designated release owner. Do not infer
approval from attendance. Store the approver ID and approval timestamp.

## Audit Output

Record explicit approval from the designated release owner. Do not infer
approval from attendance. The audit output must quote the approval statement
and include the source message ID.

Adjacent explanatory sentences saying that explicit approval matters may be
merged, but the authority evidence and audit evidence are separate contracts.
